typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ReportData as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CONCAT([Action],[Member_ID],[Last_Name],[First_Name],[MI],[SSN],[DOB],[Start_Date],[End_Date],[Admission_Date],[Plan_Code],[Provider_ID_Type],[Provider_ID],[Reason_Code_1],[Reason_Code_2]) AS ReportData FROM ##IN_LTSS_EXTRACT_Data_Final',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODW
ODW derive(ReportData = ReportData) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATA = ReportData)) ~> INLTSSFile
